rationale: Grady brings deep expertise in FDA-regulated digital therapeutics and AI-powered medical devices—areas where Manjot's 15-year track record scaling mobile app development and cross-platform solutions (iOS, Android, React Native) across healthcare, fintech, and education could add immediate technical velocity. Grady's focus on building the next generation of psychiatric care platforms aligns with Manjot's vertical AI SaaS and healthcare domain experience, creating a potential complement between regulated medtech product vision and proven mobile/backend execution.
intro_message: Manjot Singh, meet Grady Hannah — Grady is scaling RAMHT, a digital therapeutics platform for mental health, and your healthcare mobile development expertise and cross-disciplinary tech stack could be valuable as he builds AI-guided medical devices for regulated markets.
